buttonClasses: .button / .button.primary / .button.secondary / .button.accent, in p.button-wrapper (no paint: the source has no button system)

tokens.--font-brand: "Helvetica Neue LT ESO", "Helvetica Neue LT ESO Fallback", "Helvetica Neue", helvetica, arial, sans-serif (weights 400 Light / 400 italic / 600 Roman / 700 Medium)
tokens.--font-brand-light: "Helvetica Neue LT ESO Light" (35 Thin), "Helvetica Neue LT ESO Light Fallback"
tokens.--font-brand-caps: "Helvetica Neue LT ESO", "Helvetica Neue LT ESO Caps Fallback" (header menu labels)
tokens.--content-inset: 10.5% (the source's left/right inset for titles and paragraphs)

iconFonts.Material Icons: .material-icons with ligatures search, fullscreen, keyboard_arrow_right (subset: only these)

foundation.base: body #000 / #fff, 1rem, line-height 1.5; p + ul margin 0 0 1rem; li padding 1rem 0 (site rule L15690 — reset it in block lists); a and a:hover #fff, no underline; headings keep UA defaults (no global heading scale — blocks set their own)
foundation.breakpoints: the source's own tiers: width <= 576 / >= 576, 768, 992, 1200, 1440, 1680, 1920; desktop chrome at >= 992

sections.scaffold: main > .section margin 0; main > .section > div max-width none, margin 0, padding 0 — every band is full-bleed, blocks own their inner layout
sections.styles: section-metadata `style` (ONE value): light (pad 2rem 0 0, bg --light-bg, #000, links --esoblue), light-tight (pad 0), dark (pad 2rem 0 0, #000), dark-tight (pad 0), darkblue (pad 2rem 0 0, --darkblue-bg)

header.--nav-height: 50px (= --topbar-h; the fixed #top-navbar at every width; <header> reserves it)
header.--main-nav-height: 69px reserve for #main-navbar before the header inserts it (>= 992)
header.mainBar: nav#main-navbar.header-nav.main-navbar, inserted into <main> right after the big-header section (first in <main> when a page has none); >= 992 only; .mysticky (sticky top 50px) / .myfixed (fixed bottom) morph + dropup/dropdown flip on scroll; z-index 1020
header.navDocument: /nav (English), /chile/nav (Spanish menu labels + search strings) — set `nav: /chile/nav` in the /chile/ page metadata
header.active: computed from location.pathname (top item by section prefix, menu entry by exact path; ELT HOME when nothing matches)

hero.block: big-header (foundation-owned, blocks/big-header/) — every page's FIRST section
hero.rows: row 1: hero picture (fixed, parallax 0.5, under the top bar); row 2: <h1> title — a <strong> run is the orange section label ("**About** | The road to the ELT")
hero.variants:
home (front-page title:

+

subtitle), facts (1.5rem title below 576px)
hero.frame: .big-header-text height 46.875vw; logo block (ESO logo + 'European Southern Observatory') comes from /nav section 6
hero.note: sections after the hero must paint their own ground (the hero image is position: fixed behind the page)

foundation.footer: footer .site-footer (#202020), one row: brand line + link line, from /footer
foundation.langMetadata: page metadata `lang` sets <html lang> (es-cl on /chile/); default en
foundation.fontsLicensing: fonts/LICENSING.md — Monotype kit, licence to confirm before production (R-01)
